projects.title: Translating Culinary Tales: Regional Chinese Dishes
projects.full_description:
Hello,

I’m interested in helping you translate and adapt your cultural guide about 8 regional Chinese dishes.

What caught my attention is that this project is not simply a word-for-word translation. The stories behind these dishes are just as important as the food itself, so the Chinese version needs to feel natural, warm, and culturally respectful.

I can adapt your English source material into fluent Simplified Chinese that is easy and enjoyable for a general Chinese reader to understand. I will focus on preserving the original meaning while making the wording feel natural in Chinese, rather than sounding like machine translation.

Here is a short sample based on your provided material:

麻婆豆腐｜四川

四川麻婆豆腐以独特的麻辣风味闻名。相传，这道菜诞生于19世纪，由一位脸上带有麻子的女性创制，因此得名“麻婆豆腐”。如今，麻婆豆腐早已成为中国最具代表性的经典菜肴之一，也是四川饮食文化中令人难忘的一道美食。

小笼包｜上海

上海小笼包以薄而柔韧的面皮包裹鲜美浓郁的汤汁，是一道既讲究味道，也讲究吃法的传统美食。吃小笼包时，通常需要先在面皮上轻轻咬开一个小口，让热汤慢慢流出，再小口品尝汤汁，最后享用整个小笼包。看似简单的一道美食，却需要一点耐心和技巧，也正是这种从容的吃法，让品尝小笼包成为一种独特的体验。

兰州牛肉面｜甘肃

甘肃兰州牛肉面以手工拉制的面条和清澈鲜美的汤底闻名。面条由师傅现场拉制，粗细和口感各有讲究。这道面食不仅是兰州人日常生活中的美味，也是这座城市引以为傲的饮食象征。在当地，一些深受欢迎的牛肉面馆常常排起长队，只为一碗看似简单、却承载着浓厚地方特色的牛肉面。

I would apply the same approach to all 8 dishes: natural Chinese writing, engaging storytelling, accurate terminology, and careful attention to the cultural significance of each regional dish.

I’m available to start promptly and can work according to your preferred format and deadline.

Thank you for considering my proposal. I’d be happy to work on a sample or the first section so you can evaluate the writing style before proceeding with the full guide.

Best regards,
Bradley

• A spreadsheet of 40–50 curated book titles with short annotations explaining each title’s relevance.

projects.title: Full-Time Bilingual Property Management Accountant – 60+ Rentals | $500/Month
projects.full_description:
Full-Time Bilingual Property Management Accountant / Virtual Assistant

Remote Position | Full-Time | $500 USD per Month

We are a growing U.S.-based property management company managing 60+ rental properties. Our portfolio includes short-term, mid-term, long-term, and room rentals.

We are looking for a full-time Bilingual Accountant / Accounting Virtual Assistant who can take ownership of the day-to-day accounting and financial reporting for our portfolio.

This is not simply a data-entry position. We need someone with real accounting experience who understands financial statements, reconciliations, income and expense categorization, and property-level accounting.

Schedule & Compensation

* Full-time position
* Approximately 40 hours per week
* $500 USD per month
* Long-term opportunity
* Remote
* Preference for candidates located in Latin America
* Must be able to maintain consistent working hours and communicate regularly with our management team

Primary Responsibilities

You will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records across our portfolio of 60+ rental properties, including:

* Tracking and categorizing all income and expenses
* Maintaining separate accounting records for each property
* Preparing monthly Profit & Loss Statements for every individual property
* Preparing and maintaining Balance Sheets
* Preparing portfolio-wide financial reports
* Performing bank and credit card reconciliations
* Tracking rental income from multiple sources
* Tracking management fees
* Recording cleaning, maintenance, repair, utility, insurance, tax, and other operating expenses
* Managing Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable
* Reviewing transactions for incorrect or missing classifications
* Investigating discrepancies and missing transactions
* Maintaining supporting invoices, receipts, and financial documentation
* Assisting with cash-flow tracking
* Helping management understand the profitability and financial performance of individual properties
* Communicating with our operations team regarding expenses, payments, invoices, and financial discrepancies
* Helping improve and standardize our accounting processes as our portfolio grows

Required Qualifications

We are specifically looking for someone with a strong accounting background.

You should have:

* Minimum 2 years of accounting or professional bookkeeping experience
* Experience preparing Profit & Loss Statements
* Experience preparing or maintaining Balance Sheets
* Strong understanding of:
 * General Ledger accounting
 * Accounts Payable
 * Accounts Receivable
 * Bank reconciliation
 * Credit card reconciliation
 * Income and expense categorization
 * Financial reporting
* Experience managing multiple properties, companies, locations, projects, or cost centers
* Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills
* Excellent attention to detail
* Strong organizational skills
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to identify accounting errors instead of simply entering transactions
* Reliable computer and internet connection

Language

English and Spanish bilingual preferred.

Our remote operations team includes team members throughout Latin America, so you should be comfortable communicating in both English and Spanish.

You do not need perfect English, but you must be able to communicate effectively with management and understand accounting-related instructions in English.

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to applicants with experience in:

* Property management accounting
* Real estate accounting
* Short-term rental accounting
* Airbnb
* VRBO
* [login to view URL]
* QuickBooks
* Zoho Books
* Property management software
* Owner statements
* Multi-property financial reporting

The Person We Want

We are not looking for someone who only enters transactions.

We want someone who can look at the numbers and recognize when something does not make sense.

For example, if:

* An expense is assigned to the wrong property
* Income is missing
* A bank account does not reconcile
* An expense has been duplicated
* A property’s P&L looks unusual
* A payment cannot be identified

We expect you to investigate the issue and bring it to management’s attention.

Our goal is to have reliable financial reporting that allows us to see exactly how each property is performing.

Accounting Skills Test

Qualified candidates will be asked to complete a short accounting skills assessment before being hired.

The assessment may include:

* Categorizing transactions
* Assigning expenses to the correct property
* Reconciling transactions
* Identifying accounting errors
* Preparing a basic property-level Profit & Loss Statement

The purpose of the assessment is to evaluate practical accounting ability rather than certifications alone.

How to Apply

Please answer all of the following questions:

1. How many years of accounting or bookkeeping experience do you have?
2. Have you worked in property management or real estate accounting?
3. Have you managed accounting for multiple properties, locations, or companies simultaneously?
4. Which accounting platforms have you used?
5. Have you prepared Profit & Loss Statements yourself?
6. Have you prepared or maintained Balance Sheets?
7. Describe your experience with bank reconciliations.
8. What is your English level?
9. What is your Spanish level?
10. What country are you currently located in?
11. Are you available to work full-time?
12. Are you comfortable with compensation of $500 USD per month?
13. Are you willing to complete a short accounting skills assessment?

Please begin your application with the words:

PROPERTY ACCOUNTING

Applications that do not answer the questions above may not be considered.

We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team as our property management portfolio continues to grow.

projects.title: Organic Artwork CNC Vector Redraw
projects.full_description:
Project Description
I am looking for an experienced vector artist/CAD designer to take an existing original artwork concept and
professionally redraw it as clean vector artwork suitable for fabrication from 6 mm aluminum plate using
CNC laser cutting.
The artwork will NOT be posted publicly. Images and detailed design information will be provided privately
only to the freelancer I select.
The selected freelancer will be required to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before receiving
the confidential artwork, detailed design files, or other proprietary project information.
This is not simply an image-tracing or automatic JPG-to-DXF conversion project. The selected freelancer
must be capable of preserving the artistic character of an organic design while creating clean, accurate,
fabrication-ready geometry.
The finished piece will be approximately 24 inches (610 mm) in diameter and contains numerous
decorative openings that will be completely cut through the aluminum. These openings will later be filled with
translucent colored epoxy resin and illuminated from behind.
The designer must understand how to create attractive organic shapes while maintaining appropriate
minimum web widths, minimum opening sizes, structural connections, closed contours, and cuttable
geometry in 6 mm aluminum.
Required Skills and Deliverables
• Excellent artistic/vector drawing ability.
• Demonstrated experience preparing DXF files for CNC laser cutting, waterjet cutting, or similar
metal fabrication.
• Ability to manually redraw/refine artwork rather than simply auto-trace it.
• Understanding of closed contours, minimum web widths, kerf considerations, duplicate lines, intersecting
geometry, open vectors, and other common DXF fabrication problems.
• Ability to preserve symmetry and precise dimensional relationships.
• Final drawing must be exactly 24.000 inches (609.6 mm) outside diameter at 1:1 scale.
• Deliver fabrication-ready DXF, editable AI or SVG, and a high-resolution PDF showing the completed
design.
• DXF must contain clean cutting geometry with no duplicate entities, stray points, unnecessary nodes,
overlapping lines, or unintended open contours.
• Reasonable revisions are included until the supplied artwork has been accurately reproduced and the
DXF passes a basic fabrication review.
Confidentiality and NDA
Signing the NDA is a condition of receiving the artwork. The selected freelancer may not copy, publish,
post, share, distribute, sell, reuse, display in a portfolio, or disclose the artwork or project files without my
prior written permission. The NDA must be signed before confidential artwork or detailed design information
is released.
English Fluency Required
English fluency is required. We will need to communicate about precise artistic and fabrication details, so
applicants must be able to communicate clearly in written English.
IMPORTANT - FIXED PRICE
This project will be awarded at an agreed fixed total price.
Your bid must be your complete price for the project. The price will not be renegotiated or increased
after the project is awarded. Please review the requirements carefully before bidding. Do not submit a low
initial bid with the intention of increasing the price later.
After selection and NDA execution, the freelancer will receive the confidential artwork. If the freelancer then
believes the work cannot be completed for the submitted fixed price, the freelancer may decline before work
begins. Once the freelancer accepts the artwork and begins the project, the agreed fixed price will not be
renegotiated.
When Applying
Please provide examples of decorative metal artwork, laser-cut artwork, CNC/waterjet designs,
complex vector illustrations, or DXF fabrication files you have personally created.
Also answer these four questions in your proposal:
1 What software will you use to redraw the artwork and produce the final DXF?
2 Have you previously produced DXF files that were actually used for CNC laser or waterjet cutting of
metal?
3 Does your bid represent your complete fixed price for the work described above?
4 Are you willing to sign an NDA before receiving the artwork?
Please do not bid unless you can answer all four questions

We are looking for imagery that feels premium, photorealistic and cinematic — dramatic mountain terrain, beautiful natural vegetation, realistic golf-course presentation, atmospheric lighting and strong depth.

Final images must be high resolution and suitable for large-format printing and professional presentations.

We would like to approve the initial masterplan treatment and proposed camera compositions before final high-resolution rendering.

When bidding, please provide 2–3 examples of YOUR OWN work most relevant to this project.

We are particularly interested in previous work involving:
• Golf courses
• Large-scale landscapes
• Resorts/masterplanned developments
• Mountainous terrain
• High-end aerial CGI / visualisation

Please state your total fixed price and expected delivery time.

CONFIDENTIALITY: All project information supplied is confidential. Project drawings, images, models and final visualisations must not be shared, published, distributed or used in portfolios/social media without our written permission.

projects.title: HD Graphics Renderer for MAME Arcade Game
projects.full_description:
C++ / MAME Developer Needed for HD Graphics Renderer for Classic Arcade Game.

We are developing an HD visual remaster system for Atari game running through a custom MAME build. The goal is to preserve the original game logic, controls, physics, collision detection, timing and level layout while replacing/upgrading the visual presentation.

We already have a custom MAME 0.281 build compiling successfully, RGB32 rendering working, access to the scrolling 128×64 tilemap/world coordinates, a Lua world-mapping tool, and several working proof-of-concept builds.

We need an experienced C++ graphics/emulation developer to help implement a robust world-aligned replacement rendering system capable of displaying new high-resolution environmental artwork in place of the original 8×8 tile-based graphics while preserving original sprites/game behavior where required.

Experience with MAME internals, C++, tilemaps, sprite compositing, 2D rendering, texture atlases, OpenGL/BGFX/SDL, emulator development or HD texture replacement systems is highly desirable.

projects.title: Skilled Video Editing Assistance
projects.full_description:
I need a set of raw video clips turned into a polished, watch-ready piece. The core task is straightforward: take the existing footage, shape the narrative through clean edits, and deliver a final file that plays smoothly from start to finish. 

Please work non-destructively so I can request tweaks, and keep an eye on pacing—no dead air or jarring cuts. If you feel certain effects, transitions, or colour tweaks would lift the piece, let me know; I’m open to creative touches as long as they enhance clarity and flow. 

Deliverables 
• Final video in 1080p (H.264 MP4) 
• Project file from your preferred editor (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve all welcome) 

Once the first cut is ready, share a low-res preview link for review. Two rounds of revisions should be plenty to get the timing, titles, and overall feel locked in. 

Everything else—music licensing, extra graphics, or advanced colour grading—can be discussed if you think it will benefit the story.
